description: This file defines constants, functions, and types related to optional bundled clusters in the openclaw project. It includes exports for string constants, sets, environment variable identifiers, and functions to determine whether certain clusters should be included or built based on environment variables and package configuration.

methods.name: export function isOptionalBundledCluster(cluster: string): boolean; isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if the given cluster string is considered an optional bundled cluster.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines whether optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variables.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if the package JSON indicates a released bundled install.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides if a specific cluster should be built, considering environment variables and options.
